application/json.title: Armor Agent Logs
application/json.subTitle: This plan includes logs from the Armor Anywhere agent that such as OS, file logging ,vulnerability scanning,intrusion detection, malware protection, and file integrity monitoring. This plan allows you to store and search all of your logs for 30 days.
application/json.helpText: Logs are stored for the duration of the retention period subscribed; this plan applies to sources other than each agent or OS which are already included in each agent. This plan is required for all log collection services when forwarding logs from any network device, application, or other non included source.

application/json.title: 13Month Extended Log Retention
application/json.subTitle: This plan allows you to store and search all of your logs for 13 months
application/json.helpText: Cost are only incurred for the month in which the data is transferred. Data is stored for the duration of the retention period subscribed. Applies to all source; agent, host or other.

application/json.title: Security/Analytics Consumption
application/json.subTitle: Included with your Armor Anywhere agent licenses, this plan allows you to store and search all of your logs for 30 days.
application/json.helpText: Logs are stored for the duration of the retention period subscribed; this plan applies to sources other than each agent or OS which are already included in each agent. This plan is required for all log collection services when forwarding logs from any network device, application, or other non included source.
